name: PM vocabulary coach (exam-prep by correction)
summary: a passive skill that corrects a misused project-management term with ONE trailing ≤50-word block (right term · why · why yours was wrong, tagged to an exam domain), keeps a glossary of deliberate house terms it must never correct, logs each correction to an append-only file with a fixed schema, and nudges on domains that never come up
requires: a harness that loads skills passively from a standing rule in the instruction file
retires: separate study time for vocabulary the day's work already surfaces, and the nagging about house terms used on purpose
